ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a terrain profile along the 16° latitude line. The horizontal direction is marked with longitudes such as about 80°W, 70°W, 60°W, 50°W, and 40°W. The left end is A, and the right end is B. Near A on the western side of the profile, the elevation is very high, with tall mountains, and the highest point can reach more than 6000 meters; eastward it passes through lower plateaus and plains, and finally reaches the coast near B on the eastern side. From the feature of 80°W to 40°W and tall mountains on the western side, it can be judged that this continent is South America, the high mountains on the western side are the Andes Mountains, A is near about 16°S on the west coast of South America, and B is near about 16°S on the east coast. Then reason: The route in the question is from point A first going south along the west coast, reaching near the southern end of South America, then turning north and walking along the east coast all the way to point B. Along the way, it will pass through natural zones such as the tropical desert zone, subtropical evergreen hard-leaved forest zone, temperate forest or temperate grassland on the west coast of South America, and it will also pass through related subtropical and tropical forest or grassland natural zones on the east coast. But the subarctic coniferous forest zone is mainly distributed in high-latitude areas of the Northern Hemisphere, and there is no typical subarctic coniferous forest zone along the coast of South America. Therefore, the natural zone not passed through along the way is the subarctic coniferous forest zone.

<image1>

某人从A处先向南，后转向北沿海岸线一直走到B处，沿途没有经过的自然带是什么？
